title: VOLT RALLY
oneLiner: Place your returns, charge your shot, and win the first-to-seven duel.
mechanics: First to seven points. Missed returns award the opponent one point.
Paddle contact position and paddle movement control the outgoing angle and spin.
Hold A during a rally to charge a faster return; charging reduces movement speed.
One player faces a finite-reaction CPU; two players control separate opposing paddles.

controls.a: Serve; hold during rallies to charge a power return

lose: The opponent wins seven points, or leads at the time limit. A tied limit enters sudden death.
scoring: 100 per point for the player who wins the rally.
note: Original catalogue foundation; no commercial game assets.
